why: I3Learn is a named web-based instructional platform that others could adopt, rather than a general instructional element or merely a course design.
name: I3Learn
product_description: I3Learn is a WordPress-based web learning platform developed for independent, inclusive ion-bonding chemistry learning by 9th- and 10th-grade students.

why: The I3 Model is a named practice framework for integrating evidence-based practice/quality improvement, research, and innovation in nursing care, not a general theory of learning.
name: Inquiry, Improvement, and Innovation (I3) Model
product_description: A framework developed by Hagle and colleagues to help clinicians and graduate nursing students select and apply evidence-based practice or quality-improvement, research, and innovation methodologies to improve patient care.
